questions: What is extinction?
After extinction, can it come back?
What does transfer mean?
After a transfer, does it work the same way somewhere new?
What is load?
If the load gets heavier, does performance always get worse?
What does practice change?
If practice stops, can performance still improve?
What does priming do?
After priming, does it stay ready indefinitely?
What is interference?
If the interference is removed, does the original come through exactly as before?
What does conditioning do?
If the conditioning stops, does behavior soon return to how it was?
What is memory?
When memory is full, does it have to erase something before taking in anything new?
What is bias?
If the bias is corrected, are decisions then neutral?
What is a signal?
If the signal is weak, does it always go unnoticed?
What is focus?
If the focus shifts, does everything else become blurry?
What is a cue?
If the cue is missed, does the response fail to occur?
What is a threshold?
Once the threshold is crossed, does it stay crossed?
What is a filter?
If the filter blocks something, is it completely gone?
What is a script?
If the script changes, do the same events still happen?
